Question B-005-001-008. Lesson link: L-005-01.

Why the correct answer is right: One ampere is 1 000 milliamperes. One quarter of that is 250 mA.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: This is one hundredth of an ampere, not one quarter.
- sourceIndex 2: This confuses amperes and milliamperes; 0.25 mA is much smaller.
- sourceIndex 3: This uses microamperes and is 1 000 times smaller than 250 mA.
